newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly track crude lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly track crude lower.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Wednesday.

Premium unleaded gasoline barges shed $2-$3 a tonne after U.S. stock data showed a sharp rise in gasoline inventories last week. But naphtha was firmer with a strong bid of $185 for prompt pipeline spec material.
Gas oil prices were sharply weaker after bearish U.S. crude and gasoline stock builds sent futures tumbling.
Slack demand in Europe also put pressure on barge and cargo differentials to gas oil futures, adding a further 50 cents to $1 to overall losses.
